name: Devin Code Scans
desc: Scheduled sweeps that look for a class of problem across the codebase.
desc_zh: 按计划在整个代码库里排查某一类问题的智能体扫描。
solves: One-off reviews only see the diff in front of them; a scan keeps looking for the same pattern everywhere and files what it finds.
solves_zh: 一次性审查只看得到眼前的 diff；扫描会持续在整仓找同一类模式，并把发现的问题开成条目。
best_for: You want every call site of a deprecated API found before the migration starts.
best_for_zh: 迁移开始前，想把某个废弃 API 的所有调用点都找出来。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — devin.ai/blog directory）。 Distinct from the Devin Security threat model announced later; Code Scans is the generic sweep surface with a Findings view. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方名字只是「Code Scans」，加上产品名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://devin.ai/blog/introducing-code-scans
